entities.name: Blood Feud & Clan Vengeance
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Before law codes, justice was personal. If someone killed your kinsman, your entire clan was obligated to take revenge — often escalating into multi-generational feuds. The cycle of retaliation could destroy both clans. This was the default "justice system" for most of human prehistory.
